original.statement: The alpha, unmaintained external secret stores feature is removed in Crossplane v2; users must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-0c1262a1a2a5] puts External secret stores under "Removed features" and tells users of the feature to migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading. That is a required operator step, so the migration family with change type migration-required fits. The name external-secret-stores is short kebab-case taken from the evidence's own words.
